reason: My Instagram agents always surprise me with extra charges when the parcel lands, so a written quote with every fee and nothing extra on arrival is worth testing. I'd send one small order of phone accessories to see if the total really matches before I move my stock orders over.
objection: They're new and I pay the item price up front. If the parcel takes six weeks instead of three, or they say it's heavier than I thought, my money is stuck and I can't restock on time.
would_change_my_mind: If the first order comes in over the quote or late, I go back to my usual agent. A lower buying fee for resellers who order in bulk would make me move all my orders.
